name: Bradford County, PA
findings: Bradford County has 265 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bradford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 hobby and sports organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
